- Weather: real rain in three depths (many far fine drops, a middle layer, a few near long bright ones) leaning with the wind, rings where drops land on the ground and a light mist; the scenery and the sky both use it.
- Keyboard: a copied file (music, video, an APK, a document) waits in the bar's right slot to be pasted into a chat, from a copy in the cache (nothing is saved elsewhere). Game Hub: the native GPU shelf is on by default where it is available (Game Hub settings turns it off).
- Keyboard menu: the first row is Gamepad, Emoji, AI fix and Key layout; the password manager (Quick auth) is a tile of the menu instead of an icon in the top bar.
- Game Hub native shelf: boxes slide in one after another, the middle one floats and leans with the swipe, a launch animation takes the box towards you before the game starts; a header (title, count, clock, position), search, details, flip and menu buttons. It is the default where it is available.
- Keyboard: a screenshot or picture that lands on the clipboard takes the bar's right slot from an older copied text. Screen cover Neofetch: the card is sized to its real width, so the lines are no longer cut at the right. Opening animation has a length setting (short, normal, long); the start screen of Android stays until Pulse has drawn its first frame.
- YTXTube has an opening animation (the red play button pops in with a soft ring and fades, under a second); the Game Hub native shelf's intro and launch animations are shorter.
- Game Hub launch screen: the box picture is shown whole with rounded corners (its top band and bottom were cut).
- Game Hub: Select games works in the native settings (the phone's games, hidden games, other apps; a tick keeps a game on the shelf). Closing another Pulse app no longer stops a YTXTube video in the picture-in-picture window.
- Game Hub, Select games: unticking a game hides it for real from the phone (pm hide, with root or Shizuku) and ticking it shows it again; without them it is kept off the shelf only.
- YTXTube: pulling down from the lower part of the player page (comments, more videos) puts the video in the middle of a black screen (portrait stays); pulling down from the upper part still goes to the mini player. Keyboard: a picture is pasted through the system paste in fields that do not declare pictures.
- Game Hub (web shelf): the Select games list opened behind the settings panel (so nothing seemed to happen); it now opens above it.
- YTXTube: the player's 10-second buttons are previous and next video (previous goes back through what was played); a video fades out when another is picked and the next fades in; a song fades out in its last two seconds so the next follows without a cut; Library is the last tab, after Saved.
- Game Hub: with root or Shizuku the games it knows are games are hidden from the phone by default (CoC, CR and the rest; the ones you show again stay visible); Select games lists the hidden games on top (they fold away) and every app of the phone below, a tick hides the app. Without root or Shizuku nothing can be hidden from the phone.
- Files, wide screens: the columns are as wide as the longest name; icons are smaller on a phone and bigger on a tablet; the view icon opens a small menu in place (Columns, List) instead of switching back; the right pane scrolls, shows the first lines of a text file (txt, bat, log …) in white on black, and has an open-with button at the bottom right.
- YTXTube: the zoom label at the top of the video just says Reset (no zoom amount); pinching out zooms back as before.
- YTXTube: a dead zone round the edge of the video (28 dp): swipes that start there, such as the ones for the quick panel and notifications, no longer move the brightness, the volume or the player.
